title: Remove 43 unused DotNet alias declarations
summary: Removed 43 unused DotNet alias declarations from the DotNet Aliases app that had no consumers anywhere in the repository, reducing total declarations from 517 to 474.
key_points: Deleted 43 unused type declarations across 6 assemblies (DocumentFormat.OpenXml, netstandard, System.Security.Cryptography.Xml, MimeKit, MailKit, System.Drawing.Common)
All 49 assembly blocks retained and verified to be non-empty after deletion
Changes limited to a single file (dotnet.al) with 168 deletions and 0 insertions
No external extensions can consume these aliases because DotNet interop requires OnPrem target while partners target Cloud
Zero-usage scan performed across all 36,684 AL files to confirm none of the 43 aliases were referenced
quote: Over time it accumulated alias declarations that nothing consumes.
